summary_en: The video features a cooking show demonstration on how to prepare a hot and sour shrimp soup in a studio kitchen. The chefs prep and chop vegetables, sauté garlic, boil the broth, and season it with Thai hot pot spices. Shrimp, banana blossoms, and herbs are then added to the pot before the finished soup is served in a bowl, followed by a recipe wrap-up.
